targets.text: Culture Nodes is presentable and operable from Jira and its own site: the 5-minute sweep runs green again and a failed sweep names its reason where an operator looks; pending human decisions are collected in one view with up to 3-4 options each, echoed onto the Jira ticket, and stale ones expire when their PR merges; repeat sweep runs no longer bury real work in the runs list; the site's four visible defects are fixed and every ticket has a reachable page link; the backlog is honest — every issue that no longer reproduces is closed on evidence and every big feature is a named issue — and every fix package in this cycle is assigned through culture-nodes itself. This is the clean floor before the OAuth / login-from-anywhere cycle.
the delivery summary can tick every clause of the announcement against a run id, a commit or a docs/ artifact, and any clause it cannot tick is listed as not delivered

The pr-upkeep sweep runs green again on prod: the three sweep grants (GITHUB_TOKEN, SONAR_TOKEN, NODES_EVENT_TOKEN) are re-granted on thor as a recorded hand-turn with an issue, install-secrets.sh's Jira lane merges into runner-secrets.env instead of truncating it (deploy/prod/install-secrets.sh:740-758), and a deploy-time check diffs every published workflow's environmentRefs against the runner grant so a missing ref fails the deploy, not the next 180 runs

install-secrets.sh has a test that starts from a runner-secrets.env holding five keys, runs the Jira lane with the pair unset, and asserts the other three keys survive; and the deploy on thor and orin fails closed, naming the ref, when a published workflow's environmentRefs names a key the runner grant lacks

A contract_rejected attempt carries its reason where an operator looks: the runner's error.message is copied onto the attempt result, the attempt.completed event, the nodes-op run view and the web run page — the sweep wall stayed invisible for 19 hours because internal/runners/dispatch.go:206 maps StateRejected to StatusContractRejected and drops the message (issue #241, now with a measured cost)

a StateRejected result produced by a fake runner with error.message X shows X on GET /v1alpha1/runs/{id} (attempt result), in the attempt.completed event payload, in nodes-op run output and on the web run page — one test per surface

Repeat sweep runs stop burying real work: the runs list and board show the workflow key and a state filter, consecutive failed sweeps with an identical rejection reason are collapsed or filtered by default, and N consecutive sweep failures raise a human task or notify instead of accumulating silently

with 50 consecutive failed sweep runs sharing one rejection reason seeded in a test store, /runs renders one collapsed row with count 50 and a workflow key, and the 51st sweep with the same reason does not mint a run; the Nth consecutive failure creates a human task or a notify event (N is a deployment setting)

Pending human decisions are visible in one collected view: a Decisions/Inbox tab lists every pending human task and proposed claim grouped by ticket/run, each with up to 3-4 concrete options (approve / reject / defer / expire) decided in place under the held token; today /decisions renders 158 forms into a 113k-px page and /inbox has no pagination

GET /v1alpha1/human-tasks?status=pending grouped by run/ticket feeds a Decisions tab that renders 200 pending items paginated (≤25 per page) with 3-4 option buttons per item, and clicking an option POSTs the matching decision under the held token and removes the item

Every pending human task is echoed onto its Jira ticket as a comment listing the options and the page link, and a task whose subject PR is already merged expires automatically; today 26 pending pr-upkeep 'human-merges-pr' approvals on prod are for PRs #236/#238/#244/#246 which are all merged, and nothing in internal/notifier or examples/pr-upkeep posts a human task to Jira

a human task created on a run whose input names a Jira issue produces exactly one Jira comment (options + absolute page link), one transition to 'Waiting for decision', the options on /tickets/<id> and one notify post; a task whose subject PR is merged transitions to expired with reason pr_merged inside one sweep interval — proven on a new SCRUM ticket by comment ids and task ids

One in-flight pr-upkeep run per finding id: the sweep re-emits an unresolved Qodo finding on every PR head change, and each emission mints a new run and a new approval — pr236-qodo-1 has four running runs (01M1636D, 01M163RN, 01M1641W, 01M164B1) across two head SHAs

the sweep, given the same open finding id across two head SHAs, emits one pr-upkeep.pr event while a run for that finding id is running (test with a seeded running run), so the four-runs-for-pr236-qodo-1 shape cannot recur

The site's four measured defects are fixed: /stats reports a cache hit rate above 100% (588%) because cached_input_tokens is divided by input_tokens instead of input+cached (internal/api/types.go:205, web/src/domain/usage.ts:40); Node Graphs says 'No runs yet' for every workflow because recent runs come from the global last-50 list which is all sweeps (web/src/routes/NodeGraphs.tsx:139-169, GET /v1alpha1/runs has no workflow filter); the board clips the cancelled column at 1440px with no scrollbar; the runs list is capped at 50 with no Load more while Jobs already has the cursor pattern

unit tests pin: cache ratio = cached/(input+cached) ≤ 100%; Node Graphs recent runs come from GET /v1alpha1/runs?workflow_key=... (new filter, tested) and a workflow with runs never renders 'No runs yet'; the board container has overflow-x auto with a visible scrollbar at 1440px; /runs has Load more using the Jobs cursor

Sub-hour site polish lands as one package: route-specific document.title, header link to docs and a /v1alpha1/version readout, run id printed once on the run header, shared control styling and labels-above-inputs on /plan and /workflows/generate, state chips and humanised timestamps on the runs list, a label on the Decisions per-record checkbox, claim statements rendered as text not escaped JSON, a scroll affordance on board columns and mobile tables, a 'load a sample' on /workflows/new, a Tickets entry in the header nav

each polish item is a checked box in the PR body with a screenshot pair (before/after) from the Playwright route shots, and the vitest suites for Header, RunView, PlanView, GenerateWorkflow, RunsList and Decisions pass

Every ticket gets a reachable page link: NODES_UI_BASE_URL is wired into compose.thor.yml (api, worker, scheduler) and prod.env via install-secrets, so jiraticketreport.go renders an absolute URL instead of the bare path '/tickets/SCRUM-N'; GET /v1alpha1/tickets/{id} gains ticket_url composed from the fact's details_url so 'Open in Jira' always renders; and #200 signal 9 is re-measured on a new ticket after the fix

with NODES_UI_BASE_URL set on thor, a new ticket's page-link comment is an absolute URL (SCRUM-N comment id cited), GET /v1alpha1/tickets/<id> returns ticket_url, and #200 signal 9 shows one link comment across two intake milestones

A human-facing 'drive Culture Nodes from Jira' page exists in docs/ and is linked from README and the site header: what a ticket must contain, which status or comment triggers which flow (To Do -> intake, In Progress -> /think, bare comment -> consumer, marked-question reply, PR merged -> freeze), what each system comment means, how to open the page and reply and where the token comes from, what Done means and who moves it; and deploy/prod/README.md names every runner grant (GITHUB_TOKEN, SONAR_TOKEN, NODES_EVENT_TOKEN, Jira pair) and where it lives

docs/<name>.md exists, is linked from README.md and the site header, and a person following only that page creates a ticket, answers a question and decides an approval on SCRUM without an operator step other than being handed the token; deploy/prod/README.md lists the five runner grants and their file

The sweep's Jira fact carries the ticket description so intake and think agents see the ask (examples/pr-upkeep/pr_upkeep_jira.py jira_work_items) — today the intake instruction is 'Using ONLY the issue fields in your input' and the input is id, title, status, severity, kind, details_url
the jira work-item fact carries description, and the intake run's claims on a new ticket quote a phrase that exists only in the ticket body

The runner's completion notification to the API stops returning 405: every 5 minutes thor's nodes-runner logs 'completion notification for att_... was refused with 405 (polling still learns the outcome)' — runner posts to CallbackPathFormat /v1/runner-operations/{id}/events and the API at 66a3b26 does not accept that method there
one hour of thor's nodes-runner journal after the fix contains zero 'refused with 405' lines and the API test suite covers the runner's completion POST path

Every fix package in this cycle is assigned through culture-nodes (nodes-operator assign to codex-thor / codex-orin, or the developer lane), with the run id and ledger cited in the PR; in-session work is limited to the operator lane: merge gates, hand-turn grants on hosts, and issue closure
every PR in the cycle names its run ids in the body; a PR whose package was typed in-session says so explicitly with the reason

No OAuth, login, TLS, per-user identity or replacement of the shared NODES_HUMAN_DECISION_TOKEN_SECRET in this cycle: #235, #111 and #6 stay open as the next cycle's scope; this cycle only RECORDS every LAN-reachability and personal-credential dependency it finds as that cycle's input (thor:18080 HTTP-only on 192.168.1.146, runner :17070, NODES_API_URL as a LAN IP in runner.env, actor endpoints at DHCP addresses #248, one Basic-auth Jira pair that is the operator's personal Atlassian account used by sweep, bridge and both skills)
the dependency audit record lists each item with file:line or a prod GET, and nothing in the cycle's PRs changes auth, TLS, the shared decision secret or the Jira credential

Issues closed now on evidence already in hand, each with a closing comment citing it: #205 (0 dial-in 401s in 1h/24h on bridge d2f8ad2 vs plane 66a3b26, presence connected, failure_count 0), #203 (delivery record docs/deliveries/2026-08-19-jira-operating-surface-flow-store.md), #125 (fix node completed on prod runs 01M16KGAEH9867BWJPKMADG426 / 01M16JXY2ZP24KM7ANNQR9F2Q3 / 01M16JMT12KQ94PEYHA5BC50J2, developer.json repo_identities), #117 (audit run 01M08681PJK1MD6CRRX50Z7TD3, security half routed to #6/#111), #248 (retyped Record, closed via close-issue.sh --artifact docs/audits/2026-08-29-agents-as-os-users-cutover.md), #136 (duplicate of #121's done-when)
each of the six closing comments cites the evidence named in c21; #248 is closed by scripts/close-issue.sh --artifact and carries type Record

Small-fix issues (each ≤ ~1h, dispatched as work packages through nodes-operator) closed by their fix landing: #116 (internal/engine/complete.go:300 stamps StartedAt=CompletedAt=now; take StartedAt from the invocation row), #162 (DispositionTableError in scripts/triage-report.py, exit 1 not 2), #172 (rewrite examples/pr-upkeep/README.md §The graph against sweep-cycle + v2), #241 (render attempts.result.error.detail on run view / attempt.completed / nodes-op, and persist the runner rejection message on the StateRejected path too), #186 (POST /v1alpha1/namespaces over the existing sqlc insert; register-actor.sh uses it), #133 and #135 (install-secrets.sh audit compares URL password to POSTGRES_PASSWORD; env_has last-wins; no DATABASE_SSLMODE beside a URL; no hostname literal), #178 (fix 2: ledger AttemptID only when the row exists), #183 legibility half (reject an origin_actor_id mismatch at accept time), #10 items 1-2 closed by comment and item 3 split out, #147 interim (EnvironmentFile line on the intake/planner/verifier units), #128 (delete the pre-deploy dump; decide the runner event token)
each fix lands with a test that fails on main and passes on the branch, and the issue is closed by the merging PR referencing it

Decision-record closures: #129 (accept or bound the polled-forever orphan, docs/decisions/), #221 (write the SonarCloud boundary split down; a nodes sonar verb is #218 territory), #171 (record the unauthenticated artifact-read posture and add one publish->consume example) — each closes as a Record pointing at its docs/decisions/ artifact
each docs/decisions/ record exists on main and its issue is closed by close-issue.sh --artifact pointing at it

Measurements that close or re-scope issues, run in one sitting on a new Jira ticket after the sweep is green: #200 signal 9 (one page-link comment across two intake milestones; GET /v1alpha1/tickets/<id> shows one page_link), #230's remaining items (decide human task 01M16FX0BWK9X6TKE9BHAAW88Y, jira_bot_account_id per the open question), and the 27 stale approvals expired or decided
one docs/audits/ note records the sitting: ticket key, run ids, the human-task decision, and the before/after pending-task counts

Stays open as named work, untouched here: #121 (0036 cutover, absorbs #136/#248 residue), #120 items 1-3 (refuse-on-unadvertised handover; only human-inbox deployment.py is a small piece), #181 (advisory lock ceiling), #182 (async lost-resume mirror, all-backends), #173 (wait timeout edge — engine feature, though this cycle's freeze finding depends on it), #145, #88, #12's remaining canvas editor, and the big-feature issues this cycle files: decisions-on-the-ticket-page, board moved by the system, actor-side Jira read, fleet-health sweep, silence timeout, Runs list server-side filters, Inbox/Decisions pagination
every named item exists as an open typed issue at cycle end (Feature/Task/Bug) and none of them is touched by a cycle PR except by comment

A code node's stdout is readable again from the API: the sweep result's stdout_ref (artifact://<ns>/01M18ZKNP9AH5B7V169SGC0DPJ) is served by no route — GET /v1alpha1/attempts/{id}/artifacts lists [] and /artifacts/{id} is 404 — while on 2026-08-19 the same route returned the sweep's stdout (memory jira-peer-surface-scrum3-probe); fold into #171's read side or restore the attempt-scoped read
GET /v1alpha1/attempts/{id}/artifacts/stdout returns the sweep's stdout for a green sweep run on prod (run id cited) and a test covers the code-node stdout path

Freezing a ticket (PR merged) cancels or parks every run whose subject is that ticket, with a recorded reason on each run and on the ticket page — the spec-chain run 01M16GMQMWYCA0EW0V7MHHQFWN is still 'running' on Done ticket SCRUM-5, parked on q2 (comment 10209); replaces the freeze half of rejected c11

freezing a ticket in a test store with two running subject runs leaves both cancelled (or parked) with reason ticket_frozen, and on prod the SCRUM-5 spec-chain run 01M16GMQMWYCA0EW0V7MHHQFWN is no longer 'running' after the fix is deployed

The silence-timeout edge on a signal-parked question (#173: until.signal plus duration, timer row written at park time) is an engine feature and stays a named issue outside this cycle; a frozen ticket's parked runs are handled by c28's cancel/park, not by a timeout — replaces the timeout half of rejected c11
#173 carries a comment naming c28 as this cycle's freeze handling and stays open; no PR in the cycle adds a duration to until.signal

Three readers: a human on the Jira board and the ticket page who has never opened a shell (files a ticket, answers a question, decides an approval from the options offered); an agent actor (codex-thor/orin, developer) that picks up an assigned package and reports back through the ledger; and the operator who reads the runs list, the collected decisions view and the backlog and must see real work first, not fifty red sweeps

the docs page (c12) is walked by each reader role on a new ticket: a human with only the page link and token, an actor via an assigned package run id, and the operator via the runs list and decisions view — each walk is logged in the measurement sitting record

Today: the sweep was dead for 16 hours with no visible reason and 184 red runs on the first screen; 27 pending decisions sit in a 113k-px page nobody is paged to, 26 of them for PRs already merged, four of them duplicates of one finding; the ticket page link is a bare path; a Done ticket still has a running spec-chain; agents cannot see the ticket description; the stats tile says 588%; the backlog has six issues whose closing evidence already exists and twelve one-hour fixes waiting behind them; README and the guide never mention Jira
each before-state number is reproducible from a GET recorded in the frame's scope entries (s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s8, s10, s11, s12) as of 2026-08-30

After: the runs list opens on real work with sweeps collapsed under a counter; a failed node names its reason on the run page; the Decisions view lists every pending decision with 3-4 options and the same options are on the Jira ticket, the ticket page and Discord; stale approvals expire on merge; every ticket carries an absolute page link and its page shows 'Open in Jira'; freeze ends the ticket's runs; agents receive the ticket description; the four site defects and the polish bundle are shipped; six issues are closed on cited evidence, twelve on landed fixes, three on decision records, and every remaining big feature is a typed issue; a docs page tells a human how to drive the loop from Jira; and every fix package cites the culture-nodes run that produced it
each after-state clause maps to at least one confirmed requirement (c2-c10, c12-c15, c21-c24, c27, c28) and is verified by that requirement's honesty condition

The OAuth / login-from-anywhere cycle puts the site and the ticket page in front of people outside the LAN; it should open onto a floor that is green, legible and honest, and the credential-dependency list this cycle records is that cycle's input — otherwise the first thing a new login sees is a wall of failed sweeps and a decisions page it cannot scroll
the audit record from c16 is linked from #111 and #6 before the OAuth cycle's /scope starts

Signal 1 — sweep health: seven consecutive days of pr-upkeep-sweep-cycle runs on prod with zero contract_rejected attempts, or a human task raised within 15 minutes of the first rejection, cited by run ids
measured from GET /v1alpha1/runs filtered by the sweep workflow key over 7 days after deploy, or by the human task id raised on the first rejection

Signal 2 — decisions reach the human: a fresh SCRUM ticket that mints a human task gets, within one sweep interval, a Jira comment with the options and the absolute page link, a 'Waiting for decision' status, the same options on /tickets/<id> and a Discord post; deciding on the page resolves the task and the count of pending tasks on prod drops to the genuinely open ones (no task whose PR is merged)
measured on one new SCRUM ticket with comment ids, the transition id, a /tickets/<id> GET and the notify post id, plus GET /v1alpha1/human-tasks?status=pending before and after

Signal 3 — backlog honesty: GitHub open-issue count on agentculture/culture-nodes falls from 53 by at least the 21 closures named in c21/c22/c23, every closure comment cites a run id, a commit or a docs/ artifact, and scripts/triage-report.py regenerates with zero untyped issues
measured by gh issue list --state open count and a triage regen with zero untyped rows, both cited in the delivery summary

Signal 4 — dogfooding: every PR in this cycle lists the culture-nodes run id(s) that produced its packages, and at least the twelve small fixes in c22 plus c7/c8/c13/c14/c27 were produced by codex-thor, codex-orin or the developer lane, not typed in the operator session
measured by grepping every cycle PR body for run ids and cross-checking each id against GET /v1alpha1/runs

challenge / failure-modes: c4's suppression of repeat sweep runs is a backoff, not a stop — after a suppressed tick the schedule still probes at a bounded interval (at most every 30 minutes, the disabled pr-upkeep-sweep cadence) so a repaired grant is discovered without an operator resume; and the N-consecutive-failure alert is one open human task per schedule, re-raised only after it is decided

with a fixed failing runner, a 5-minute schedule mints at most one run per 30 minutes and exactly one pending alert task exists at any time; when the runner is fixed the next probe run completes with no operator action (test in internal/engine remint/schedule tests)

challenge / adjacent-systems: the deploy-time grant check (c2) diffs only workflows reachable today — the latest version per workflow_key with an enabled schedule or trigger — not all 104 published versions on prod (GET /v1alpha1/workflows), and it prints key names only, never values, on every path including failure

a test with two versions of one key where only the older declares an extra ref passes; a test with a missing ref fails naming the key; grepping the check's output for any value from a fixture secrets file finds nothing

challenge / rollback: every deploy lane that rewrites runner.env or runner-secrets.env (install-secrets.sh Jira lane, runner-env-write.sh, the new grant lane) writes a timestamped backup beside the file first and prints the restore command; deploy/prod/README.md documents the rollback
after a deploy run on a fake host, runner.env.bak-<ts> and runner-secrets.env.bak-<ts> exist with the prior bytes (tests/deploy), and the README names the restore command

challenge / migration: new migrations in this cycle number from 0049 upward; migrations/pending/0036_retire_stored_participant_addresses.sql stays unapplied and is neither renumbered nor merged into the applied sequence (#121: merging it dropped endpoint_ref and failed 14 tests)
migrations_test.go still passes with 0036 in pending/, and no cycle PR touches migrations/pending/

acceptance_criteria: three files exist under docs/decisions/ on the branch, each closed issue points at its file

tasks.summary: [developer] Human-task fan-out and expiry in the engine: on human-task creation emit one fan-out per task — for a run whose input names a Jira key: one Jira comment (options + absolute page link) and a transition to Pending (second allowlisted target on the jira bridge); for a github_pr-sourced run: one GitHub PR comment; always one notify (Discord) post carrying the options and the page — and a pr.merged consumer that expires tasks whose subject PR merged (reason pr_merged); backfill command for the 26 existing stale approvals
acceptance_criteria: engine test: one task -> exactly one Jira comment record, one transition, one notify record (Jira-keyed run); one PR comment + one notify (PR-sourced run); the same task twice emits nothing more
